# Pinterest

> > Pinterest is a visual discovery platform for finding ideas in lifestyle, fashion, and home, with developer APIs for shopping, conversions tracking, and ad management.

Pinterest enables users to discover and save creative ideas through visual bookmarking (pins), while providing businesses with APIs for product catalogs, conversions tracking via Pinterest Tag, and shopping integrations. The platform features trending content across categories like fashion (Adidas Sambas, Adidas Campus), travel (Visit California, Stockholm), and technology.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest API
- Pinterest Conversions API
- Pinterest Tag
- Pinterest API for Shopping
- Product catalogs
- Conversions tracking
- Shopping ads
- Analytics integration
- Ad management
- Content management
- Visual discovery
- Trending ideas
- Fashion trends
- Lifestyle inspiration

## Developer Platform & APIs

- [Pinterest Developers](https://developers.pinterest.com/): Pinterest API platform for developers with Conversions API and Shopping API
- [Pinterest Developers Portal](https://dev.pinterest.com/): Developer portal for Pinterest API, Tag, and Shopping integrations

## Content Discovery

- [Explore the Best of Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/): Browse curated collections and trending ideas across lifestyle categories
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://ie.pinterest.com/today/): Handpicked trending content in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and more

## Optional

- [Home Account Profile](https://ca.pinterest.com/home_account/): User profile page for home_account on Pinterest
